effects: Before every owner-controlled start, bind the exact public downloader nickname and idle selected_project=none/concurrency=1 to the retained shared recipe. No auto project or archival downloads/uploads are approved.

Startup POSTs https://warriorhq.archiveteam.org/api/register.json when warrior_id is absent, sends runner version, and privately persists the returned identity. Startup and ten-minute POSTs to /api/update.json send warrior_id, downloader nickname, selected_project and null lat_lng; HQ receives network source address and runner user-agent. This is not offline startup.

HQ metadata and broadcast responses are processed; version/max-age responses can cause container-local shutdown/reboot. No Docker socket or host privilege is granted. Outbound HQ-only policy is reviewed but not enforced by a network firewall; no archival project is selected.

Idle resource budget: Compose limits CPU to 1 and memory to 512 MiB; require 1 GiB free local storage. No disk quota or HQ bandwidth cap is implemented. Archival CPU/disk/bandwidth/destination authorization remains separate and unfinished.

Prepare or privately validate writable UID-1000 config.json before every owner-controlled start; preserve upstream warrior_id on resume and refuse authentication/nickname/project/concurrency drift. Generated HTTP Basic credentials do not create an administrator or API key.
